name: count
does: exact line (wc -l), non-empty line, word and byte counts

name: find-files
does: find files by name, case-insensitive glob, skipping build/.git folders

name: find-def
does: where a class/struct/enum/function/macro/alias is defined or declared

name: call-sites
does: every use of a symbol, grouped by file, without its definitions and comments

name: diff-files
does: byte-for-byte compare (sha1), whitespace-only check, unified diff; also directories

name: xml-check
does: XML well-formedness with xmllint

name: changed-files
does: uncommitted changes in a git repo (read-only: status + diff --stat)

name: route
does: which lead the routing rules would pick for a ticket

name: library-check
does: duplicate notes and file:line references that no longer match the code

name: weekly-report
does: a team's week in numbers: tickets, costs, ratings, staff, problems

name: choose-model
does: the expected-value model's pick of model and effort for a task, with the full table

name: jev
does: ask Jev (TypeSafe router via OpenRouter) which model and effort fit a task

name: skills-scan
does: every Claude Code and office skill: type, size in tokens, uses, pinned model

name: suggest-routines
does: jobs done by hand 3+ times and repeated corrections, as routine/memory suggestions

name: cache-report
does: cold prompt-cache reloads in your chats and whether keep-warm pings would pay

name: workspace-map
does: draft the CLAUDE.md map and department routers (writes only a proposal), or list images without descriptions

name: artifacts-index
does: rebuild the artifacts inbox page, newest first, searchable

name: token-usage
does: where Claude Code tokens went: by kind, source, project, model, day; what fills the context (tool results carried per call); biggest results; costliest sessions

name: usage-index
does: every model call on this machine with exact token counts, attributed to you, agent, team, job, project, model; context breakdown per call

name: routing-report
does: how model picks turned out: Jev vs EV vs overrides vs pins — done rate, cost, time, ratings, sent back, retried

name: arms-selftest
does: tests ARMS approvals (memory map, skills, status line, keep-warm), keep-warm pings and Recos setup in a throwaway HOME; proves real ~/.claude is untouched
